scope: Pinned local source inspection only. No code changes, builds, tests, route/interface/file mutations, target access, SSH, boot, firmware or hardware work. Only this new report is written. Qualified public002 remains finite selected-peer DNS/HTTP evidence, separately recorded.
conclusion: Fresh feth10.0.2.15/0 cannot synthesize a default through this IPv4 ifaddr API: zero mask becomes classful /8. A distinct ADD-only default route attached to a fresh owned utun is a plausible source-grounded alternative: delete nothing from userspace; close owned utun even after uncertain ADD, then verify all owned routes/interface gone. Kernel protocol detach purges routes by actual ifp identity under rnh_lock, including static routes. This is a new implementation/admission design, not authorization to revive the blocked raw ADD/DELETE prototype.

feth_findings.fact: SIOCAIFADDR copies the supplied mask into ia_subnetmask. in_ifinit treats ia_subnetmask==0 as unset, substitutes IN_CLASSA_NET for10.0.2.15, and derives ia_subnet10.0.0.0. Consequently supplied /0 installs an ifaddr network /8, not default. SIOCSIFNETMASK1060-1071 only changes address mask fields; it does not install a new route. Reinitializing the address re-enters the same zero-mask fallback.

Ordinary ifaddr route cleanup is kernel-owned: IFA_ROUTE triggers rtinit_locked; under rnh_lock DELETE checks rt_ifa pointer identity and refuses static routes. That safe ownership mechanism does not make a /0 address possible.

feth attaches DLT_EN10MB BPF but unpaired feth output drops packets before the fake output tap. BPF write sends outward via dlil_output, not directly as interface input; a pair is the source-grounded topology: stack on owned A, capture/input-facing BPF on owned peer B, inbound BPF write on B delivers to A. Closing BPF/control descriptors does not destroy persistent feth clones; explicit destroy of both owned clones and async absence verification would be needed. This is unnecessary complexity for the ADD-only utun option.

add_only_utun_contract.setup: Exclusive finite manager context; capture complete baseline interface/address/IPv4 route inventory, require no existing unscoped/scoped default, no foreign route/address to local10.0.2.15 or peer10.0.2.2. Create a fresh owned utun, set local10.0.2.15/32 peer10.0.2.2, verify exact name/index/flags/MTU/address/peer/mask and actual peer route before ADD. Preserve original FD ownership even if later local setup fails.
add_only_utun_contract.request: New separately reviewed bounded AF_ROUTE RTM_ADD only, exactly once: dst0.0.0.0, explicit IPv4 zero netmask, IPv4 gateway10.0.2.2, flags UP|GATEWAY|STATIC (no HOST/IFSCOPE/CLONING/REJECT/BLACKHOLE), AF_LINK RTA_IFP with actual owned index and bounded name, RTA_IFA exact local10.0.2.15. rtm_index alone does not select ifp unless IFSCOPE, and IFSCOPE would make a scoped rather than ordinary default. Use pinned ABI and fresh pid/seq-correlated bounded ACK parser. No RTM_CHANGE/DELETE or retry after uncertain delivery.
add_only_utun_contract.initial_selection_source: route.c:1690-1840,2273-2351: gateway flag selects ifa_ifwithdstaddr(peer), then gateway route lookup may take precedence. Therefore the unique preverified owned peer route is necessary, not merely cosmetic IFP metadata. Route insertion first sets rt_ifa and rt_ifp from this initial selection.
add_only_utun_contract.explicit_selection_source: rtsock.c:575-634,998-1125; if.c:1278-1325: after successful ADD, rt_setif executes while rnh_lock is held; AF_LINK IFP index selects interface link ifaddr, then ifaof_ifpforaddr(local,ifp) obtains protocol address. rt_setif is void and can leave selection unchanged on failure, so source does not make malformed/foreign IFP an error automatically. Never treat successful ACK alone as binding proof.
add_only_utun_contract.readback: Before any public use, require correlated actual GET/full route inventory identifies default dst/mask0, gateway10.0.2.2, exact owned index and protocol IFA/local15; required/allowed actual flags must be derived from pinned in_rmx behavior and fixed before execution (PRCLONING/IFREF may be kernel additions). Validate gateway route still points to owned peer. Reject foreign/default interference and unexpected fields. Do not borrow selected-peer HOST-route flags for a default route.
add_only_utun_contract.failure: Short write, query error, lost/malformed ACK, unexpected binding/readback, deadline or endpoint failure stays failure. Regardless of whether ADD succeeded, close owned route socket and owned utun; never send raw DELETE, never retry ADD, never clean a foreign interface. Unknown ADD ACK cannot justify success, but does not make same-ifp kernel cleanup unknowable.
add_only_utun_contract.cleanup_source: if_utun.c:2083-2215,2219-2312: control disconnect attempts address removal and AF_INET protocol detach; calls ifnet_detach, completion asynchronous. dlil.c:5645-5770 purges addresses and unplumbs protocols; dlil_subr.c:490-517 if_proto_free calls if_rtproto_del. if.c:6107-6156 takes rnh_lock across route-table walk and deletes an UP route only when actual rt_ifp pointer equals the detaching ifp. There is no RTF_STATIC exemption. This check and delete share the routing lock, avoiding userspace GET-to-DELETE replacement races.
add_only_utun_contract.clones_and_static: route.c:2222-2255 clones inherit parent ifa (and then ifp) and strip STATIC; route.c:2086-2100 deletes cloning descendants through rt_fixdelete. Independently, full if_rtproto_del walk covers every UP same-ifp route including STATIC parent and surviving same-ifp child routes. Distinct routes subsequently rebound to a foreign ifp are intentionally not deleted. Such a foreign default is a cleanup failure/interference, not permission to delete it.
add_only_utun_contract.cleanup_verification: Keep cleanup failure sticky. After utun close, boundedly require interface/name/index and local/peer address absence, no IPv4 routes referencing retired owned index, peer/local/default route absence, and exact baseline inventory restoration including foreign routes. A single GET is insufficient to prove absence of scoped defaults/clones. The close return is insufficient because detach may be delayed or log errors; if verification deadline expires, fail and rely on outer verified-Linux recovery, never assert cleanup.
add_only_utun_contract.limitations: Kernel cleanup locks actual pointer identity, stronger than an interface-name/index snapshot. Userspace still lacks a namespace lease against another privileged manager; exclusive context plus baseline/readback/interference checks remain required and are not atomic kernel ownership. Lost ACK cleanup is covered only when insertion was bound to the owned ifp; initial peer selection and exclusive context are essential. No guarantee that every possible concurrent malicious route rewrite can be safely undone.

resolver.ordinary_libc: libSystem/stub/CMakeLists.txt:160-178 force-loads XPC_libinfo_static and mDNSResponder_dnssd_static. XPC/libinfo/libinfo.c:2408-2470 getaddrinfo goes through si_search/si_addrinfo. search_module.c:941-981 actual default modules are cache,[optional muser/ds],mdns,file; mdns_module.c uses DNSServiceCreateConnection/QueryRecord. No direct getaddrinfo-to-resolv.conf fallback is established. Writing resolv.conf alone does not start a resolver.
resolver.libresolv_distinction: libresolv/res_init.c:1162-1163 first asks dns_configuration_copy; unavailable service falls back to /etc/resolv.conf. libSystemConfiguration/dnsinfo/dnsinfo_copy.c:84-133 returns NULL when DNS configuration server unavailable. This applies to res_ninit family, not proof ordinary getaddrinfo works without daemon/configuration.
resolver.native_daemon_option: Pinned src/Userspace/mdnsd builds native mdnsd using mDNSPosix/PosixDaemon.c and mDNSPosix.c with POSIX_BUILD. Posix platform parses nameserver from /etc/resolv.conf (mDNSPosix.h119; mDNSPosix.c918-944) and mDNSPlatformSetDNSConfig855-881 intentionally preserves that list rather than supplying configd servers. Thus current native POSIX mdnsd plus RAM resolv.conf is a source-grounded resolver route without introducing a libc stub or requiring configd first. A full configd-managed dynamic network is separate work.
resolver.launch_and_endpoint: Run owned /usr/sbin/mdnsd -debug foreground; PosixDaemon.c120-136 otherwise daemonizes and under __APPLE__ exits. Existing plist uses -debug for supervision but its RunAtLoad/KeepAlive is not a bounded experiment ownership plan. DNSService default Unix socket is /var/run/mDNSResponder (dnssd_ipc.h83-86). Must first prove no existing daemon/socket/service owner; do not unlink a live/ambiguous endpoint. Fresh RAM root and absent endpoint are preferred.
resolver.ram_setup: Stage into the new disposable RAM image only: real regular root-owned /etc/resolv.conf containing exactly nameserver10.0.2.3 newline; no persistent host/etc or symlink following. Existing image.nix489 already stages this content but actual selected minimal image must be checked, not assumed. Preserve/hash any preexisting RAM file or refuse disagreement; create in trusted directory with exclusive nofollow temporary file, mode0644, full checked write/close and atomic publication only under exclusive boot context. Prepare trusted RAM /var/run and private bounded mdns logs, no configd store mutation. Start daemon only after default/peer routes and bridge are verified.
resolver.qualification_and_cleanup: New actual guest getaddrinfo(AF_INET) fixture must resolve a fixed permitted name through owned mdnsd and10.0.2.3 with correlated DNS bytes, then actual TCP connection/EOF; distinguish cache from newly observed wire query. Parent owns daemon PID from spawn, waits under bounded TERM/KILL/reap policy; stop resolver before retiring utun, verify UDS absent/stable no foreign owner, restore/remove only exact owned RAM files. Source does not establish daemon runtime support, installed binary availability, privilege-drop permissions, or resolver latency. No live setup done.

exact_default_wire_followup.ADD_request: Base rt_msghdr92/version5/type1, flags0x803 UP|GATEWAY|STATIC, pid/seq positive signed32, zero errno/inits/metrics/reserved. Bitmap0x37 DST|GATEWAY|NETMASK|IFP|IFA, bit-order sockaddrs four-byte padded: DST16 AF_INET0, GW16 AF_INET10.0.2.2, MASK16 AF_INET0, AF_LINK IFP actualownedindex/name, IFA16 AF_INET10.0.2.15. No IFSCOPE: rtm_index alone does not select ordinary unscoped route interface.
exact_default_wire_followup.critical_zero_mask_request: rtsock.c1280-1283 rt_xaddrs treats sa_len0 as compatibility terminator and returns immediately. Thus a zero-length REQUEST mask skips following IFP/IFA. Encode full16-byte AF_INET zero mask in ADD and GET requests. RESPONSE zero-mask handling is separate.
exact_default_wire_followup.ADD_ACK: rtsock.c575-634 and841: successful ADD ACK echoes request plus DONE, expected0x843. It does not expose actual kernel PRCLONING/GLOBAL flags or actual assigned interface. Successful ACK must precede independent real GET readback. Unknown/malformed/missing ACK remains failed, close ownedutun/no retry; do not convert readback to success.
exact_default_wire_followup.GET_request: Type4, flags0 (no HOST/IFSCOPE), dst0 with explicit16-byte zero mask for exact lookup. Include both IFP and IFA addressbits/body with bounded selected actual metadata so rtsock.c685-695 returns kernel rt_ifp/rt_ifa. Fresh pid/seq. Do not accept echo-only failed response as real binding.
exact_default_wire_followup.GET_mask: radix.c649-684 trims allzero mask to radix zero root. rtsock.c1494-1508 emits sa_len0 as exactly four zero bytes via ROUNDUP32(0), retains NETMASK bit, then continues later addresses. Permit this ONLY for NETMASK, require allfourzero, consume4 and interpretmask0. Reject zero-length DST/GW/IFP/IFA, missing mask, nonzero mask/address padding, truncation/trailing data. This does not permit zero-length request mask.
exact_default_wire_followup.GET_flags: in_rmx.c144-146 requires PRCLONING on unicast non-HOST/non-CLONING default; GET actualflags plus DONE is0x10843 UP|GATEWAY|STATIC|PRCLONING|DONE. route.c2487 under NECP adds GLOBAL0x40000000: exact0x40010843. Current staged T8103 DEBUG->BASE->VPN->necp config and pinned MASTER81 indicate NECP selected, but staged config is not upstream pin; ROOT MUST bind actual native50 generated NECP config before fixing exactpredicate. NECP0 build would require exactly0x10843. Do not permit either arbitrarily. IFREF not justified on parentdefault: route.c3823 requires rt_parent+WASCLONED. Exclude IFREF/IFSCOPE/HOST/LOCAL/BROADCAST/CLONING/REJECT/BLACKHOLE and other unexpectedbits.
exact_default_wire_followup.GET_IFP_IFA: Expected bitmap0x37: dst/gw/mask/actualIFP/actualIFA; genmaskNULL. sockaddr_dl offsets len0,family1,index2LE,type4,nlen5,alen6,slen7,data8 (if_dl.h96-110). Variable kernel link sockaddr length may exceed20: bound length>=8, family18, exactheaderindex==ownedindex, nlen+alen+slen<=len-8, exactownednamebytes, type/linkaddress fixed from actual owned interface baseline. IFA exact16-byte AF_INET local15, zeroport/reserved. DST/GW exact16 AF_INET0/peer2. Reject missing/unexpectedfields, foreignindex/IFA/name, trailingdata. Request index alone is never proof.
exact_default_wire_followup.scope: Independent source shape check only; no implementation/build/ABI artifact/runtime route claim.
